overall: Violation found for untimely approval of open-session minutes, but the board cured it by approving all outstanding minutes before the AG acted, so no further relief was ordered; matter closed by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board failed to meet the Open Meeting Law's minutes requirements: six sets approved four to nine months late and seven sets from 2012 to early 2013 never approved.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to approve meeting minutes in a timely manner.
